notes.problem: Mannequin figures dominate; the drone is a small dark primitive.
notes.fix: Table height camera, drone filling the lower half at 600 px or more; crop people to hands and forearms.

notes.problem: Faceless mannequin figures, a small dark drone, the dek printed across heads.
notes.fix: Dolly in and drop the camera so the drone on the near table fills about 40 percent of the frame width, figures behind it in defocus below the dek baseline.

notes.problem: Mannequin figures, smeared tabletop, body copy over heads.
notes.fix: Drop the camera to table height and push in on the drone with two hands working on it; figures out of the top half.

notes.problem: Loupe reads as tinted plastic; pins primitives; stub illegible.
notes.fix: A clear glass block with amber only on its rim; a dark recessed stub with an engraved stop line.

notes.problem: The loupe a flat orange rectangle, the lower bar an ambiguous trough; rod heights look like data with no drawn to illustrate.
notes.fix: One machined gauge channel filled to 97.5 with a recessed stub and stop line, pill on its face; a clear glass frame over the ten rods.

notes.problem: Ten tubes read as an abstract bar chart; the red trough competes as the subject.
notes.fix: Cut the trough and make the ten readings the hero with the score pill seated on them.

notes.problem: Grid reads as texture; enlarged pair on stilts.
notes.fix: Press the pair into a channel with an incised leader; shrink the grid to the upper half.

notes.problem: Glyphs illegible squiggles at feed size; enlarged pair reads as loose ribbons on a hoop.
notes.fix: Bleed the slab off the bottom and press the enlarged pair into a bevelled recessed well with deep casts.

notes.problem: Tracks thread thin at 432 px; enlarged pair unexplained and not in copy.json strings.
notes.fix: Crop to the field so tracks are thicker, spoofed kinks visible; caption or delete the enlarged pair.

notes.problem: Hero small in the lower third; far hills featureless dunes not frame 1's ridge.
notes.fix: Lower the eye and dolly in; re-model the far terrain as frame 1's ridge and saddle.

notes.problem: Far hills smooth blobs rather than S1's ridge; hero small in the lower third.
notes.fix: Reuse S1's crest and saddle terrain; dolly in until the drone fills the middle third.

notes.problem: Isometric tray on a flat orange field with a dead lower third.
notes.fix: Bring the held back case to the foreground filling the lower half; shift the sweep toward the deck's violet to amber studio.

notes.problem: Ghost propeller cuts the dek at into; heavy grain on the sweep.
notes.fix: Slide the ghost 8 percent right and up clear of the text; halve the grain.
